thread.title: Apple's stock surge helps push Dow futures into positive territory

author: Tomi Kilgore
title: Apple's stock surge helps push Dow futures into positive territory
text: Shares of Apple Inc. AAPL, +2.32% surged 4.4% in premarket trade Wednesday, to help push futures of the Dow Jones Industrial Average DJIA, -0.27% into positive territory, on the back of a earnings report . The price gain would add about 52 points to the Dow's price, and Dow futures YMM8, +0.02% are up 12 points. The price gain would also add about $38.0 billion to Apple's market capitalization; Apple was already the most valuable U.S. company with a market cap of $858.0 billion as of Tuesday's close, well above second-place Amazon.com Inc. AMZN, +1.03% at $767.8 billion. Apple's stock had slipped 0.1% year to date through Tuesday, while the Dow had lost 2.5%.
